author: Ujjwal Tiwari
review_text: I had the worst experience of all, worst app of Nepal, worst customer service afterwards. I had paid nea bill through esewa, esewa showed success, but money was not paid to nea, hence nea added penalty to my account. Upon inspection, esewa had just taken my money for a whole month. Now I have to pay extra penalty all because of esewa. Customer service also accepted the mistake but not paying that penalty amount. Bidesh vako vaye sue and court case garna milne, eta ta consumer court pani chaina.
